messages.subject: Invitation: 'Disclosure under PD57AD' lunchtime CLE - 16 July
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

You're invited to a one-hour CLE session on Practice Direction 57AD (Disclosure in the Business and Property Courts) on Wednesday 16 July, 12:30-13:30 in the Bishopsgate training room. Sandwiches provided. 1 CPD hour. Please reply to reserve a place.

Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant
